WITH 
m17 AS (

    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
m18 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
growth AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(m18.month, m17.month) AS month,
    m17.gmv AS gmv_2017,
    m18.gmv AS gmv_2018,
    ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / m17.gmv, 2) AS yoy_growth
  FROM 
    m17
    FULL OUTER JOIN m18 ON m17.month = m18.month
)
SELECT 
  month,
  COALESCE(gmv_2017, 0) AS gmv_2017,
  COALESCE(gmv_2018, 0) AS gmv_2018,
  COALESCE(yoy_growth, 0) AS yoy_growth
FROM 
  growth
ORDER BY 
  month
